step_description: Unblock SEC-4 by implementing an offline, deterministic P0 regression test suite for auth/CHD invariants (no secret/token logging; sanitization/redaction guarantees) and wiring it into the Hypergenium verifier so SEC-4 is evaluated (PASS/FAIL) instead of TODO/BLOCKED.
prompt_text:
You are a remediation agent executing the next Hypergenium roadmap step for this repo.

Context (source of truth)
- Rubric: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md (Rubric v0.1.0)
- Roadmap: hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-roadmap.md
- Evidence plan: hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
- Threat model (why this matters): hgm-infra/planning/lift-threat-model.md
  - THR-1: Secret leakage via logs
  - THR-4: Unsafe use in CHD environments
  - THR-5: Multi-tenant isolation failure (future expansion)
- Deterministic verifier entrypoint: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
- Current blocker evidence: hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-4-output.log (currently TODO)

Current state
- Latest rubric report: hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
- Overall status: BLOCKED
- The only remaining BLOCKED item is SEC-4: "Domain-specific P0 regression tests (auth/CHD env invariants)" because the verifier command is TODO.

Goal (definition of done)
- SEC-4 must no longer be TODO/BLOCKED. It must be backed by a real, deterministic, offline command.
- Running: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
  must produce SEC-4 = PASS when the P0 test suite passes, or SEC-4 = FAIL with actionable output when it fails.
- Evidence refreshed under hgm-infra/evidence/:
  - SEC-4-output.log (real test output, not TODO)
  - hgm-rubric-report.json (SEC-4 not BLOCKED)
- A progress note is written under hgm-infra/evidence/.

SEC-4 scope (what to test)
Implement a small, high-signal P0 regression suite that is safe to run in CI and offline. It should prevent the most dangerous classes of regressions for a library/CLI that may be used in CHD/auth contexts:
1) Redaction/sanitization invariants
   - Authorization headers, cookies, tokens, secrets MUST be redacted when sanitized for logs.
   - Card numbers / security codes MUST NOT be logged in full when sanitized.
2) Log forging invariants
   - Newlines/control characters must be removed/sanitized from log messages/fields.

The intent is NOT to prove the entire system is compliant; it is to provide deterministic regression protection for the highest-risk failure modes (THR-1 / THR-4).

Strict guardrails (anti-drift)
- Do NOT weaken the rubric requirement (SEC-4 must remain a real P0 regression suite).
- Do NOT modify any existing verifier logic besides replacing the SEC-4 TODO command with a real command that runs the P0 suite.
- Do NOT change toolchain pins, go.mod/go.sum, .golangci.yml, or any .github/workflows/* in this step.
- Do NOT add tests that require AWS credentials, CDK deploys, external services, or network access.
- Do NOT modify production code behavior in pkg/** or cmd/** as part of this step.
  - If a test reveals a real unsafe behavior, STOP and record it as a follow-up rather than expanding scope into production changes (unless explicitly authorized by maintainers).
- Keep the test suite deterministic: stable ordering, no time-based assertions, no randomized inputs.

Allowed write locations (explicit)
- You MAY edit under hgm-infra/** to wire the verifier and update planning docs for parity.
- You MAY add a NEW, test-only package under internal/ for SEC-4 P0 tests, for example:
  - internal/p0tests/** (preferred)

Step-by-step procedure
1) Confirm the baseline blocker (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json that SEC-4 is BLOCKED with message "Verifier command not configured".
   - Inspect hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-4-output.log (it should contain the TODO placeholder).

2) Implement the P0 regression test suite (offline, deterministic)
   Create a new test-only package (recommended):
   - Directory: internal/p0tests
   - File: internal/p0tests/sec4_p0_regression_test.go

   The tests must be pure-Go and offline. Suggested invariants (minimum set):

   A) Header redaction is enforced
   - Use: github.com/pay-theory/lift/pkg/utils/sanitization
   - Call: sanitization.SanitizeHeaders(map[string][]string{...})
   - Assert that these keys are redacted (exactly "[REDACTED]"):
     - Authorization
     - Cookie
     - X-Api-Key
     - X-Auth-Token
     - X-Csrf-Token
     - X-Session-Id

   B) Query param sanitization is enforced
   - Call: sanitization.SanitizeQueryParams(map[string][]string{...})
   - Assert that these keys are sanitized (exactly "[SANITIZED_QUERY_PARAMS]"):
     - token
     - api_key / apikey
     - password
     - secret

   C) Field-value redaction/masking is enforced
   - Call: sanitization.SanitizeFieldValue(key, value)
   - Assert:
     - key="authorization" value="Bearer abc" => output == "[REDACTED]"
     - key="cvv" value="123" => output == "[REDACTED]"
     - key="card_number" value="4111111111111111" => output is masked and does NOT contain the full PAN
       (e.g., must contain "411111" and end with "1111" but must not equal the original string).

   D) Log-forging prevention is enforced
   - Use: github.com/pay-theory/lift/pkg/logger
   - Call: logger.SanitizeLogString(

}
     - Output fields must have authorization == "[REDACTED]"

   Notes
   - Keep assertions narrowly focused and deterministic.
   - Do not write tests that depend on exact JSON formatting/indentation (that belongs to unit tests of SanitizeJSON; it already exists).
   - If any invariant is not currently satisfied, treat that as a real finding. Do NOT weaken the test; instead record the mismatch in the progress note and stop unless explicitly authorized to change production behavior.

3) Wire the SEC-4 verifier to run the P0 test suite
   Update: hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Replace the SEC-4 line:
     run_check "SEC-4" "Security" "TODO: ..."
     with a deterministic command, e.g.:
     run_check "SEC-4" "Security" "go test ./internal/p0tests -v"

   Constraints
   - Do not change any other rubric item commands.
   - Keep exit-code semantics unchanged (0 PASS, 1 FAIL, 2 BLOCKED only for missing tools).

4) Update planning docs for parity (required; no change in intent)
   Update these files so they no longer claim SEC-4 is TODO:
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md
     - Update SEC-4 "How to verify" to match the new SEC-4 command.
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md
     - Update SEC-4 "How to refresh" to match the new SEC-4 command.

   Optional (recommended for correctness, but keep minimal):
   - hgm-infra/planning/lift-controls-matrix.md
     - Update the SEC-4 row "Verification" column to no longer say TODO, and point at the new deterministic test command.

5) Re-run verifier to refresh evidence (required)
   - Run: bash ./hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh
   - Confirm in hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json:
     - SEC-4 status is PASS (or FAIL if a real regression is detected)
     - Overall summary is PASS if no other items are failing/blocked.
   - Confirm hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-4-output.log contains the P0 test run output.

6) Record progress (required)
   - Create: hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-SEC-4-REM-1.md
   - Include:
     - Timestamp
     - The exact verifier command for SEC-4
     - The list of invariants enforced (headers, query params, field redaction, CRLF stripping)
     - Final SEC-4 status + evidence pointers:
       - hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-4-output.log
       - hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json
     - If any test fails, include a short excerpt of the failure and explain why it is a real safety issue (do not paste secrets).

Stop conditions (do not expand scope)
- If you discover gaps that require changing production behavior in pkg/** or cmd/**, STOP and document them in the progress note instead of implementing broad refactors.
- If you are tempted to relax assertions to make tests pass, STOP (that is rubric dilution).

Deliverables
- internal/p0tests/sec4_p0_regression_test.go (new)
- hgm-infra/verifiers/hgm-verify-rubric.sh (SEC-4 command wired)
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-10of10-rubric.md (SEC-4 command updated for parity)
- hgm-infra/planning/lift-evidence-plan.md (SEC-4 refresh updated)
- hgm-infra/evidence/SEC-4-output.log (refreshed)
- hgm-infra/evidence/hgm-rubric-report.json (refreshed)
- hgm-infra/evidence/roadmap-progress-M3-SEC-4-REM-1.md
